text: {"lessons":["Five months of modest gains and losses are too little evidence to identify a reliable trading edge; I should judge decisions over a much longer horizon.","A short-term account decline alone is not a reason to trade; I should avoid reacting to noise without a clear, evidence-based reason.","Doing nothing has kept me from making unsupported trades, but outperforming the market will require a disciplined strategy rather than assuming that inaction alone is enough."]}
